# Post Templates

## LinkedIn Template

```
[HOOK — one punchy sentence about what you built or learned]

[2-3 sentences of context: what problem, what you tried, what happened]

Here's what I built:
✅ [feature 1]  
✅ [feature 2]  
✅ [feature 3]

[1-2 sentences: what surprised you or what you'd do differently]

[Call to action — question for your network, or "full code here: github.com/absep98/Go_learn"]

#Go #Golang #BuildInPublic #Backend #Learning
```

**Example:**
```
I've been learning Go for 60 days. Here's what I shipped this week.

I needed to protect my API endpoints without using any framework — just Go's standard library. Turned out to be simpler than I expected once I understood how middleware chaining works.

Here's what the backend now has:
✅ JWT authentication with bcrypt password hashing  
✅ Redis-based rate limiting (100 req/min per user)  
✅ Request ID middleware for distributed tracing  
✅ Structured JSON logging with slog

The hardest part wasn't the code — it was understanding *why* middleware runs in a specific order.

Code is all public: github.com/absep98/Go_learn — what would you add next?

#Go #Golang #BuildInPublic #Backend #WebDev
```

## Twitter/X Thread Template

```
Tweet 1 (hook):
[Bold claim or surprising statement about what you built/learned]
🧵 Here's everything I figured out 👇

Tweet 2:
The problem: [what you were trying to do]

Tweet 3:
My first attempt: [what you tried — include code snippet if possible]

Tweet 4:
What went wrong: [the failure or confusion]

Tweet 5:
The fix: [what actually worked — include code snippet]

Tweet 6:
What I learned: [the insight in one sentence]

Tweet 7:
Key takeaway for anyone learning Go:
[actionable tip]

Tweet 8 (CTA):
Full code: github.com/absep98/Go_learn
Follow for daily Go learnings 🚀
```

## Substack / Long-form Platform Template

```
[Personal opening — one anecdote or moment that prompted this post]

[The core insight or thing you learned — stated plainly in 1-2 sentences]

[Walk through what you built, in plain English — no jargon dump]

[The moment it clicked — what made it make sense]

[What's next / what you're still figuring out]
